import json, subprocess, time, random

def run(doc):
    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    t = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=raw, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
    dt = time.time()-t
    if p.returncode: print('EXIT', p.stderr.decode()[:500]); return None, dt
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode()), dt

# 2000 cases x 25 frames = 50000 frames
random.seed(0)
cases = []
for i in range(2000):
    frames = []
    for j in range(25):
        if j % 5 == 4:
            frames.append({"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":j})
        elif j % 5 == 0:
            frames.append({"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["a%d"%k,"v"] for k in range(3)],"End_Stream":j==20})
        elif j % 5 == 2:
            frames.append({"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"d"})
        else:
            frames.append({"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"payload","End_Stream":j==20})
    cases.append({"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/t","host":"h"}})
out, dt = run({"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":7,"cases":cases,"events":[],"channels":[]})
print('50000 frames:', 'error' if out is None or 'error' in out else (len(out['cases']), sum(c['frames'] for c in out['cases'])), '%.1fs'%dt)

# 32768 header pairs
pairs = [["h%d"%i,"v%d"%i] for i in range(128)]
frames = [{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":pairs} for _ in range(256)]
cases = [{"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}} for i in range(1)]
out, dt = run({"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":7,"cases":cases,"events":[],"channels":[]})
print('32768 pairs:', 'error' if out is None or 'error' in out else out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], '%.1fs'%dt)

# 8192 definitions chained
defs = [["d0","b'ab'"]]
for i in range(1,8192):
    defs.append(["d%d"%i, "d%d + b'x'"%(i-1)])
out, dt = run({"seed":"s","definitions":defs,"timeout_ms":7,"cases":[],"events":[],
               "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{ d8191 }}"}]}]})
print('8192 chained defs:', 'error' if out is None or 'error' in out else out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n'], '%.1fs'%dt)

# 50000 events
events = [{"at":i%1000,"kind":"data","stream":(i*4)%8000,"data":"x","end":False} for i in range(50000)]
cases = [{"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":[],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}} for i in range(10)]
out, dt = run({"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":7,"cases":cases,"events":events,"channels":[]})
print('50000 events:', 'error' if out is None or 'error' in out else [c['state'] for c in out['cases'][:3]], '%.1fs'%dt)

# 50000 channel parts
parts = [{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"} for _ in range(50000)]
out, dt = run({"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":7,"cases":[],"events":[],
               "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":parts},{"name":"d","parts":[]} ]})
print('50000 parts (20000 req cap):', 'error' if out is None or 'error' in out else (len(out['channels'][0]['requests']), out['channels'][0]['error'], out['channels'][0]['committed'][-1]), '%.1fs'%dt)

# big literal input ~ 4MB
data = "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nX: " + "a"*60000 + "\r\n\r\n"
parts = [{"case":None,"data":data} for _ in range(60)]
out, dt = run({"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":7,"cases":[],"events":[],
               "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":parts}]})
print('4MB literal:', 'error' if out is None or 'error' in out else (len(out['channels'][0]['requests']), out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n']), '%.1fs'%dt)
